record.reason: Surfacing was appropriate: the new follow-up appointment makes the open blood-pressure question decision-relevant. The candidate supports its claims with the July clinic reading, the appointment note, and the available measurement data; it correctly says the watch cannot answer whether blood pressure fell. It recommends recording blood-pressure readings before the visit and explains that they would inform the assessment of current blood pressure and whether lifestyle changes are sufficient, without claiming salt reduction caused any change.

candidate.why_now: 10月2日有一次复诊，届时要决定生活方式改变是否足够；现在补充可比较的血压记录，能让这个决定有直接依据。
candidate.what_changed: 记录显示，7月就诊时的血压为138/88；这次复核没有找到之后的血压读数。现有手表记录的是心率和步数，不能回答血压是否降低。
candidate.unknowns: 目前无法判断血压是否比7月低，也无法单凭前后读数确认变化是由减少盐摄入造成的。
candidate.next_step: 复诊前用同一设备和相同测量方式记录一组血压读数，并带去讨论。这能帮助判断近期血压状况及生活方式改变是否足够，但不能单独证明盐摄入减少导致了变化。
